benchmark: 0050 ETF (TAIEX proxy, not entire TAIEX); known 2025 split price normalized
rules: Price/volume proxy only. MA10/20/60 rising over 5d; close above MAs and <=5% over MA20; volume>=1000 lots; avg20>=500; breakout or rebound. Includes next-open buys, next-open exits for 3 consecutive sub-MA20 closes, +20% trim one third, 30d max, 0.1425% buy and 0.4425% sell costs, no slippage. No chip/revenue/full V5. Stock sample uses surviving symbols; not all historical listings.

filter_variants.bear_confirm: During 0050 bear regime, require 0050 above MA20 for 2 sessions, stock 10d relative strength > benchmark by 3 percentage points and stock MA20 rising; otherwise skip.
filter_variants.bear_skip: During 0050 bear regime, skip all entries.
filter_variants.severe_guard: Only add veto when sustained 0050 below MA20 plus falling MA60, or 20-session -9%; can retain original strong exception.
filter_variants.reversal_entry: During bear regime, allow verified relative-strength recovery above 0050 MA10, own rising MA20, 5-session high break, 10-session outperformance >4 percentage points.
filter_variants.confirm_hold_1d: Only enter on second following open if immediate next daily close is higher than signal close, green, holds MA10 and signal low; no >5% MA20.
filter_variants.confirm_break_1d: Next trading day CLOSE must exceed original signal candle high on minimum 0.8x average volume; then enter following open.
filter_variants.bear_confirm_hold_1d: Only in bear regime, permit original soft exception, else buy only following session after positive confirmed hold.
filter_variants.fast_failure_exit: Original next-open entry; if closes below original signal low by first 3 holding days and under MA10, exit next open rather than awaiting MA20 3 consecutive days.
filter_variants.moderate_volume_all: Only accept setup-day volume 1.0 to 2.3x prior 20-day average. Historical close-known value; this exact threshold is data-mined and requires fresh out-of-sample test.
filter_variants.moderate_volume_bear: Only in 0050 bear regime, accept setup-day volume <=2.3x 20-day average; keep unmodified entries in other regimes.
filter_variants.moderate_volume_severe: Only in severe regime, accept setup-day volume <=2.3x 20-day average; keep unmodified entries outside severe regime.

method_caveat: Surviving and current-active code sample with listing-date bias; known splits adjusted only for 0050/2327, other corporate actions unverified. Trade-level weighted by opportunity, not portfolio-level annualized return. Split and slippage concerns remain.
